content:
The City of Laredo wants residents to help decide what goes on the new McPherson Water Tower mural, and a survey open now through November 13 will shape the design, according to the Laredo Morning Times.

The mural project is run by the City of Laredo Public Arts Program. The city launched a survey in the past week asking residents to rank proposed mural elements by number, the Times reported.

Residents can choose among four themes. Air features local birds and butterflies; Water features the Rio Grande and local fish; Earth features local wildlife, deer, flowers and cacti; and Fire, the wildcard theme, features cycling, running and sports.

To take the survey, residents can scan the QR code printed with the Times article. The survey closes November 13, and respondents are entered into a drawing for a free sweater.

Source: Laredo Morning Times, November 8, 2026.
